title: Infinity State Annotation Box Metadata (v1)
description: Optional visual metadata for SCJSON other_attributes.help_text_box and other_attributes.condition_text_box. This schema is a suggested Infinity State convention and is not part of core SCJSON validation.

visibility.description: Display mode for the rendered annotation.

x.description: Annotation box x coordinate in canvas units.

y.description: Annotation box y coordinate in canvas units.

width.description: User-sized annotation box width in canvas units.

height.description: User-sized annotation box height in canvas units.

spacing.description: Preferred gap between the owning object and the annotation box.
